build_XMLDataset: build a Python module to create an XMLDataset instance for object detection with custom image and annotation subdirectories
load_data_list_XMLDataset: load annotation data from XML files into a list of dictionaries using the XMLDataset load_data_list method
parse_data_info_XMLDataset: parse raw XML annotation info into structured data with image path, dimensions, and instance bounding boxes
parse_instance_info_XMLDataset: parse instance bounding box information from XML objects including coordinates, labels, and ignore flags
filter_data_XMLDataset: filter dataset annotations by minimum bounding box size and remove empty ground truth images using filter_data
